title: Simple Pancakes
description: Simple Pancakes adds flour, batter, jams, and pancakes to Minecraft!
body:
# 🥞 Simple Pancakes

### 🛠️ Features

- New Crafting Recipes: Craft wheat into flour, then combine flour, sugar, eggs, and milk to create pancake batter. Smelt the batter into plain pancakes, make fruit jams with apples, sweet berries, or glow berries and honey, and top your pancakes with them to craft variant pancakes.
  
- Thematic Food Items: Each pancake variant offers a small benefit or effect, adding variety and a fun breakfast theme to your food choices.
  
- Custom Creative Tab: All items are organized under a dedicated “Simple Pancakes” tab in the creative inventory for easy access.

### 📦 Items Included

- Flour: Crafted from wheat, used to make pancake batter.
  
- Pancake Batter: Combined from flour, sugar, eggs, and milk, ready to smelt.
  
- Plain Pancake: Warm and fluffy, a base for variant pancakes.
  
- Apple Jam, Sweet Berry Jam, Glow Berry Jam: Spreadable jams crafted from fruits and honey.
  
- Apple Pancake, Sweet Berry Pancake, Glow Berry Pancake: Pancakes topped with jams, each with a small effect.

### 🎨 Creative Tab

- All items are accessible under the “Simple Pancakes” tab in the creative inventory for a streamlined player experience.
  
**This is my second Minecraft mod, enjoy making pancakes in Minecraft! :)**
**You can include this mod in any modpack as long as you provide attribution.**
